rules.fill: default = 16:00 ET close. HARD_RED limit_5 / haircut_5 fill at open×0.95 only if that day's low printed through the limit (not close-to-close ≤ −5). haircut_5 without a print falls back to the close.
rules.hold: locked names keep their seat; new buys only fill empties
rules.fees: Futubull US schedule from 00_grounding/futubull_fees.json (same as paper blotter)
rules.sizing: whole shares; leftover cash split equally across new fills; skip if <1 share after fees
rules.orig_window: 2026-08-13 → 2026-08-21 (original live book before the late-Aug drawdown)
